Description: When you drop below 25% HP, perform a Reach AOE swing hitting all nearby enemies. Gain 1 mana per kill. Cooldown: 10 tempo
When an enemy enters an adjacent square, perform a free attack. When an enemy attacks you from adjacent, knock them back. 2 charges, 10 tempo cooldown
Gain 10% Fire, Physical and Lightning resistance
When stunned or disarmed, choose to sacrifice 5 HP to ignore the ailment
Gain 5 strength when below 50% health, lose it when going above
Every other Defense card refunds 1 mana and 1 tempo
Each cycle: more attacks in hand -> discount a random attack by 2m. More defense -> heal 3 HP
When healing (self or ally), gain crit chance on your next attack
All attacks life steal by 5%

Whenever you heal, gain 3 thorns

When discarding a card, -1t from a random card in your hand
Anytime an instant is played from your hand, gain 5 armor
When healing yourself or an ally with a Pocket card, the healed character draws a card. 5 tempo cooldown.

If an attack, your most recently drawn card has -1 mana cost. The discount is lost when any card is played
+3 dexterity and +3 agility. Your first attack each cycle deals +2 damage for each card that hit your discard pile last cycle by means other than playing it
When applying poison to an already poisoned enemy, deal immediate damage equal to 1/3 their current poison stacks
Your first strike on an enemy deals +3 damage. An additional +4 if they have no armor, and an additional +5 if you are their first source of damage
If you have cards in your hand, but no Defense cards, draw a card when you play an attack
At the end of every cycle, gain armor equal to spaces moved/2 and deal damage to the nearest enemy within 3 range equal to spaces moved

The last card you played changes the outcome of your potion cards. Utility->Heal: +3 regen. Attack->Heal: +3 strengthen. Utility->Poison: +3 poison stacks. Defense->Poison: -10% enemy physical defense.
Every third critical strike provides invisibility
+3 damage and +50% crit damage when the target has no allies within 2 spaces
Anytime you draw a Defense card and the last card you played was an offensive card, or vice versa, give the drawn card -1 tempo
+2 range on ranged attacks
When receiving Glut, deal that much damage to an enemy in melee range and halve the Glut
When exposing your enemy, deal your damage again
When struck with a melee attack, gain crit chance on your next attack equal to the number of non-attack cards in your hand
Hitting the same enemy 3 times in a row grants +6 range on your next attack and it auto-crits — usable against any enemy
Cards that have >4 tempo cost deal their tempo cost as additional damage
If you have played 4 attacks in a row, your 5th will be played twice
If you have 3 or less cards in your hand, playing a non-attack card triggers a free basic attack
When applying burn, cold, or shock, apply 1 additional instance
When triggering an attack speed proc, the proc resolves normally and you also gain a 0m/0t basic attack card (5 tempo cooldown)
Every 3rd time you gain mana from a source other than mana regen, put an Energy Barrier in your hand (0m/0t, gain 5 armor, erase 1)
When applying a debuff to an enemy below 50% health, deal 3 damage to them
Add +1 charge to all debuffs applied to enemies
When playing an attack, a utility, and a defense in any order (none back to back), heal 3 and gain 5 temp HP for 15 tempo
Killing enemies heals you 5% of your max health. You gain 1% damage for each percentage point of health the enemy is below 35%
Transfer a debuff to an enemy when you drop below 50% health. 2 charges, 10 tempo cooldown; only one charge can trigger at once
When you shuffle your deck, gain 15 armor and +3 damage for 3 attacks
When enemies enter or leave melee range, re-apply 1 random debuff they already have
When you play 3 cards in a single tempo cycle, your next card costs -1m
Regenerate health for each enemy with a debuff near you
The first time an enemy drops below 25% health, you become invisible to them. If you attack that enemy out of your invisibility, it is an auto-crit
When emptying your hand, draw 4 cards. Cooldown 25 tempo
When you have 0 mana remaining after casting a spell, your next spell costs -1 tempo
Allies near you are healed 3 health every 5 tempo
Increase all % chances by 10

Cards gain 30% effectiveness when you have 2 or less cards in your hand

When you heal an ally, add a Shepherd's Mark card to your hand (Erase 10). Play it on the healed ally to mark them for 10 tempo. If the marked ally would take lethal damage, they survive at 1 HP and gain 10 armor instead, but Jeremy takes 8 damage. Cooldown: 20 tempo.
When you cast a spell that targets an empty tile, summon a Specter on that tile for 15 tempo. 5 HP, cannot act. Enemies may target it based on proximity. When destroyed, deals 4 damage to its killer.
While retaining armor for more than 25 tempo, apply shock to the nearest enemy equal to the number of defensive cards in your deck
When spending 10 mana within 5 tempo, add a Mana Surge to your hand. Mana Surge: Attack, 0m/2t, deal 5 damage, gain 1 mana.
When an enemy attacks you and you have 3 or more defensive cards in your hand, the enemy's next action takes +3 tempo. Cooldown: 10 tempo.

Every time Jeremy takes damage (excluding Blood Libation's own self-damage), gain a stack of Sanguine (max 5). Each stack grants +1 to all healing Jeremy performs. At 5 stacks, Jeremy's next heal is doubled, all Sanguine stacks are consumed, and Jeremy takes 10 non-lethal damage. The damage resolves FIRST, then the heal
